parameters.content:
## Regression Test Runner
Test a change before you promote it to production.

Edit the **DEV** workflow, run this for a business unit (or ALL), and green means every request still routes to the right place for the right amount. Then promote DEV to prod.

### 1 - Pick a business unit

ALL, or one BU so an owner checks only their own rules. Runs on submit; the result shows on the form completion page.

### 2 - The golden set

Known requests with known-correct outcomes, filtered to the chosen BU. Add or edit a case here. Regenerated from `golden/golden_cases.json`.

### 3 - Run the real logic

Sends each case through the DEV workflow's actual decision nodes in **test mode**: no Slack, no approval wait, no event write. Not a copy, so it cannot drift from production.

### 4 - Check + summarize

**Assert** compares each returned decision to its expected outcome. **Summary** counts pass or fail and builds the report. Green means every request still routes to the right place for the right amount.

### 5 - Findings out

**Post to #regression** sends the pass/fail summary to Slack every run (a side effect, onError continue, so a Slack outage never blocks the page). **Show Result** renders the same summary on the form completion page.
